name: Ashvin Gami
headline: Founder | Innovator at StrategicERP & Centiloquy AI Orchestration
about:
Driving innovation across ITAakash Strategic Software (P) Ltd. since the year 2005 as its managing
director and innovator, Mr. Ashvin Gami’s award-winning StrategicERP solutions have been
successfully adopted by more than 100,000 users in over 600 organizations across the world.

His boundless vision to transform the world around us through technology has led him to develop an
enviable suite of advanced digital solutions. StrategicERP’s cloud-based enterprise software has
found its niche in real estate, construction, manufacturing and energy sectors among many more.

Mr. Gami has been at the forefront of utilizing his resources to aid communities around him. His
mobile application to help fight the pandemic was adopted by a state government and a farmer-
centric application helped bring fresh organic produce directly to consumers and vendors.

He strives to redefine software solutions based on clients’ inputs to create intelligent future-ready
systems.

Ashvin Gami has earned his bachelor’s degree in Electronics and Communication from the
prestigious Institute of Information Technology- Bombay (IIT-B) in India.
